Click it to open a "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"dropdown with two choices:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- 📄 **Save HTML (same directory)** — Renders the current `.md` file into a standalone `.html` and **"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"writes it directly next to the .md file** (Markdown tables / code blocks / **Mermaid diagrams** all "},{"id":"p6s3","text":"inlined; layout follows the original md preview theme — not A4 print-oriented)
- 🖨️ **Export PDF (pr"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"int)** — Opens the browser print dialog (the printed content is the rendered document); choose "Save"},{"id":"p6s5","text":" as PDF" to produce a PDF"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Zero-dependency, keeps built-in behavior**: does not replace better-sidebar's built-in Markdown "},{"id":"p8s2","text":"preview/edit (preview, edit, save and Mermaid rendering all remain); it only **appends** an export b"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"utton to the toolbar
- **What you see is what you get**: the exported HTML is taken directly from th"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"e built-in previewer's rendered DOM (including Mermaid SVG) — no second rendering pass
- **Saves nex"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"t to the .md**: writes the HTML into the md's directory via better-sidebar's `/sidebar/api/fs.write`"},{"id":"p8s6","text":" channel (same basename, `.html` extension); falls back to a browser download if session detection f"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"ails
- **Layout follows the original md preview**: the exported HTML uses the current preview theme'"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"s colors and typography (dark/light auto-follow), content width adapts — **no A4 paper size**
- **Ed"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"it-mode friendly**: if you are in edit mode with unsaved content, export automatically switches to p"},{"id":"p8s10","text":"review first
- **Auto-follow**: the button appears on the Markdown toolbar whenever the file or prev"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"iew/edit mode changes"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Prerequisites"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- DSH `dsh web` running
- dsh-better-sidebar installed (or the aggregator package `@linxin666/dsh-we"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"b-ui-all` that brings it in)"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"After installing, **restart dsh web** (a new bundle needs a host-side reload), then hard-refresh the"},{"id":"p13s2","text":" browser (Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R)."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"> Open any `.md` file in the sidebar — the "Export ▾" button appears right next to the "Preview | Ed"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"`.md` file in the sidebar — the "Export ▾" button appears right next to the "Preview | Edit" toggle."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"1. Open any `.md` file in better-sidebar (e.g. `docs/AOI端保存图片逻辑.md`)
2. Click the "Export ▾" button "},{"id":"p16s2","text":"on the toolbar
3. Choose:
- **Save HTML (same dir)**: the HTML is written next to the md (e.g. `docs"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"/AOI端保存图片逻辑.html`), layout matches the md preview
- **Export PDF (print)**: the print dialog opens; "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"choose "Save as PDF""},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- `lib/index.js` — host-side placeholder plugin (empty `apply`, so the loader entry mounts)
- `lib/c"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"lient.js` — client logic: MutationObserver watches the markdown toolbar → injects the export button "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"+ dropdown → grabs the preview DOM → saves next to the md via `/sidebar/api/fs.write` / triggers pri"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"dropdown → grabs the preview DOM → saves next to the md via `/sidebar/api/fs.write` / triggers print"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Implementation notes"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Step | How |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Button injection | `MutationObserver` watches `document.body`, finds `.nArs4W_editorModeToggle` (M"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"arkdown/HTML previewer toolbar) and injects when the current file is `.md` |
| Path resolution | Tak"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"es the md absolute path from the `.nArs4W_editorPathInput` `title` attribute; the output is the same"},{"id":"p22s4","text":" directory + same basename + `.html` |
| Session detection | Scans `localStorage` keys `dsh-sidebar:"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"v1:*`, picks the newest sessionId |
| Save to same dir | `POST /sidebar/api/fs.write` (payload: sess"},{"id":"p22s6","text":"ionId + absolute path + HTML content); falls back to a browser download on failure |
| HTML layout |"},{"id":"p22s7","text":" Reads colors/fonts from `.nArs4W_editorMd` and the page theme; exported content width adapts (non-A"},{"id":"p22s8","text":"4) |
| PDF export | Writes the same HTML into a hidden iframe → `window.print()` → user chooses "Sav"},{"id":"p22s9","text":"e as PDF" in the print dialog |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Known limitations"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- PDF export relies on the browser print feature (Chrome/Edge both support "Save as PDF"); it does n"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ot generate a `.pdf` binary directly, so PDF cannot be saved to the md directory
- HTML save-to-same"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"-dir depends on session detection (localStorage); in edge cases it falls back to a browser download
"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"- Depends on better-sidebar's internal CSS class names (`nArs4W_` prefix); if a major better-sidebar"},{"id":"p24s5","text":" upgrade changes the class names, this plugin needs a sync update
- Only applies to `.md` files; `.m"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"arkdown` extension is also supported"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
